categories.main_business_segments: China Resources Microelectronics Limited (华润微电子有限公司) operates primarily in two business segments: Products and Solutions, and Manufacturing and Services. The Products and Solutions segment focuses on power semiconductors, mixed-signal ICs, intelligent sensors, and intelligent control products. The Manufacturing and Services segment provides wafer fabrication, mask making, and packaging and testing services, supporting both internal and external semiconductor companies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturer) model encompassing chip design, mask making, wafer fabrication, and packaging/testing. Core technologies include advanced BCD process platforms, trench gate MOSFETs, IGBTs, third-generation wide bandgap semiconductors such as SiC and GaN, MEMS sensor technologies, and advanced packaging techniques including panel-level fan-out packaging and Cu-clip bonding. The company emphasizes proprietary design and manufacturing capabilities with over 2,200 patents, including 1,838 invention patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span automotive electronics (notably major Chinese car manufacturers like BYD, Geely, FAW), new energy sectors (photovoltaic inverters, charging piles, energy storage), industrial equipment, communication devices, and consumer electronics. The company serves both domestic and international semiconductor firms through its manufacturing services and targets emerging markets driven by AI, 5G, IoT, and electric vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major facilities in Wuxi, Chongqing, Shenzhen, Shanghai, and Dongguan. It also has registered offices in the Cayman Islands and Hong Kong. Its sales and manufacturing footprint covers domestic Chinese markets extensively and exports to other countries, with overseas assets accounting for a small portion of total assets.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Resources Microelectronics is positioned as an IDM, covering upstream to downstream in the semiconductor supply chain. It integrates chip design, mask making, wafer fabrication, and packaging/testing, enabling full control over product development and manufacturing processes. It also provides foundry and packaging services to other semiconductor companies, acting as a midstream and downstream supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment, focusing on power semiconductors, third-generation wide bandgap materials (SiC, GaN), advanced packaging, and intelligent sensors. It aims to enhance core technologies, expand 12-inch wafer production capacity, and accelerate product innovation in automotive electronics, new energy, and industrial applications. The company also pursues external investments and acquisitions to strengthen its product portfolio and manufacturing capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of power semiconductors, mixed-signal ICs, sensors, and intelligent control products. Additionally, the company earns income from manufacturing services including wafer fabrication, mask making, and packaging/testing services provided to external semiconductor firms. Sales channels include direct sales and distributor networks.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of China's leading IDM semiconductor enterprises and among the largest domestic power semiconductor manufacturers. It holds the top position in China's power semiconductor and MOSFET markets according to Omdia. Competitors include international leaders like Infineon and ON Semiconductor, with the company actively narrowing technology gaps and expanding market share domestically.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 9.9 billion, a slight decrease of 1.59% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.48 billion, down 43.48%. Total assets reached RMB 29.2 billion, growing 10.42%. R&D investment increased by 25.3% to RMB 1.15 billion, accounting for 11.66% of revenue. The company maintains a strong asset base and continues to invest in capacity expansion and technology development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its full IDM model with integrated design and manufacturing capabilities, enabling rapid product iteration and customized process solutions. It offers a comprehensive product portfolio with advanced proprietary technologies in power semiconductors and sensors, supporting high reliability and performance for automotive, industrial, and new energy applications. Its advanced packaging technologies and strong R&D capabilities provide competitive differentiation in quality, innovation, and supply chain security.
